T: Move in with Grandma. Eat like it.
D: A video game tester gets evicted and moves in with his grandma and her two housemates.
P: Serve the snacks when Alex moves in with Grandma.
S: Grandma's cheddar and chive cheese ball
moving in with Grandma and her housemates

An old-school cheese ball of sharp cheddar, cream cheese and chives rolled in toasted pecans, served with water crackers and celery sticks. Beat 250g soft cream cheese with 150g finely grated vintage cheddar, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/2 tsp garlic powder and 2 tbsp chopped chives until smooth. Shape into a ball, wrap in cling film and chill for 1 hour. Toast 80g pecans in a dry pan for 4 minutes, chop finely and mix with 2 tbsp more chives. Roll the cheese ball in the nuts until coated. Serve with 200g water crackers and 4 celery sticks cut into batons.

Soft pizza dough scrolls rolled with tomato sauce, pepperoni, mozzarella and oregano, baked golden and served with warm marinara for dunking. Roll 500g pizza dough on a floured bench into a 30 x 40cm rectangle. Spread with 100ml pizza sauce, then scatter with 100g sliced pepperoni, 150g grated mozzarella and 1 tsp dried oregano. Roll up tightly from the long side and cut into 12 slices. Pack into a greased 24cm tin, brush with 20g melted butter and 1 crushed garlic clove, and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until golden. Warm 300ml marinara sauce for dunking.
M: A juicy beef and pork meatloaf with a sticky brown sugar tomato glaze, served in thick slices with creamy mash and buttered peas. Soak 60g breadcrumbs in 80ml milk. Mix with 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 2 tsp Worcestershire, 1 tsp salt and pepper. Press into a lined loaf tin. Mix 100ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp cider vinegar and spread over the top. Bake at 180C for 1 hour and rest 10 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes for 20 minutes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Cook 300g peas and toss with butter.
W: A soft, buttery tea cake brushed with melted butter while warm and finished with a crunchy cinnamon sugar crust, served with whipped cream. Beat 100g soft butter and 150g caster sugar until pale, then beat in 2 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla. Fold in 200g self-raising flour alternately with 150ml milk. Spread into a lined 20cm round tin and bake at 180C for 30 to 35 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. While still hot, brush with 20g melted butter and sprinkle with 2 tbsp caster sugar mixed with 1 tsp cinnamon. Serve warm in wedges with whipped cream.
K: Black tea brewed strong, chilled and shaken with peach nectar and lemon, poured over ice with fresh peach slices and mint. Steep 6 black tea bags in 1L boiling water with 3 tbsp sugar for 5 minutes. Remove the bags and cool, then chill for 1 hour. Stir in 400ml peach nectar and the juice of 1 lemon. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and a few slices of fresh peach or tinned peach. Pour over the tea and garnish each glass with a mint sprig and a lemon wheel.
